entries.title: A task waiting for Automatic says what it waits for
entries.body: When Automatic holds a new task back, its Details and its line in Activity now say why: a computer short of spare processing capacity or memory, room set aside for other tasks that are starting, or each computer's own reason. Automatic also stops setting room aside for tasks once they are running and measured, so a new task no longer waits for room your computer has.

picture.alt: A queued task's record whose Computer choice row reads Waiting for room set aside for other tasks that are starting.
